name: Verify assistant identifies intent from natural language input
objective: Validate that the AI Assistant correctly identifies user intent when an issue is described in natural language.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open after clicking the Agentforce icon.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Type a natural language description of an issue in the assistant chat
steps.testData: "My laptop cannot connect to the VPN"
steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant identifies the intent
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies the intent as a connectivity/VPN issue

steps.description: Verify the assistant offers relevant assistance options
steps.expectedResult: The assistant provides relevant next steps (knowledge article, create ticket, troubleshooting)
